predictions: More than a bit of a bounceback last week, as I posted an 18-7 record for the week. Once again, four of the seven wrong picks could have flipped or tied on a single dart. It's a minor miracle that I ever get more right than wrong around here. Geez… As per usual, there are a few teams that are fooling me over and over and over. I've seriously underestimated McGavin, seriously overestimated Cheap Shots, and just can't figure out what will happen in a Shark Shooters match so far.

Match of the week: (E Div.) Liquor Possee @ Dart Side of the Moon. Sure, it's only week 4, but this battle of unbeatens already looms as a potential defining moment in the E race. Not only are they only two points apart so far, but they've faced two of the same teams so far and each scored the exact same against both opponents. Doesn’t get much more even than this. I think I will take Dart Side's cricket edge, 13-11.

Match #2: (F Div.) Sofa Kings @ Zero Dart Ton 80. If Sofa hadn't taken a full-on 501 nap in week 2, this would also be a matchup of 3-0 squads. Instead, this is now Zero Dart's chance to shove one of their top competitors a full two matches (plus points) back already. And I think Zero Dart is just rolling too much for an upset to come yet, 15-9.

Match #3: (D Div.) Sharky's Machine @ DD-214. With the absolute drove of D teams that all have one loss so far, any match within that group could end up being the key outcome in a couple months. This is one of the most even pairings, and I'm taking a DD tiebreaker win.

Match #4: (C Div.) Hump Day! @ The Outlaws. Well, C division has already shown itself to be an any-outcome-every-week kind of division, with two-thirds of the outcomes being 12-12 or 13-11 to this point. These two both have a loss already and really can't afford another this early. I would take The Outlaws, but… where is Shane Murray? Hump, 13-11.

Match #5: (D Div.) Ton 80 Proof @ Reload. Ton 80 Proof is in… next to last. And also has the same number of losses as the team in first! And also the same as the team in 4th, which is tonight's opponent. Just another match that torments me with its lack of clarity. Ton 80, 13-11.

Match #6: (E Div.) Bangin The Wire @ Runs with Corks. The two undefeated E teams are meeing in the match of the week above, meaning this 1-loss team battle (the 'Bangin-Corks' matchup) could propel the winner to the top competitor slot. Corks leave this happy, 14-10.

Match #7: (C Div.) Off Constantly-Reboot @ Darty Sanchez. [Oops… this match became a pre-notified forfeit after this page was complete, but before the entire issue was finished. So we are just changing this to a notice of a 16-0 forfeit win for Off Constantly.]

Match #8: (E Div.) Duck Around & Find Out @ Cheap Shots. It's week 4 now and we only have a handful of matches left guaranteed to have a team celebrating its first win of the season. Despite the Ducks almost pulling the big win last week, I'll go Cheapies, 13-11.

Match #9: (B Div.) Dart Attack @ Raging Bulls Eyes. It's only two wins and 14 points from first to last in B. If the new hybrid Raging can pull this early upset, things could flip around very quickly here. However, it feels like Attack really has something going now, 15-9.

Match #10: (G Div.) Dart Vader's @ 21 Dart Salute. Vader's sits 3-0 after three consecutive 13-11 wins. Sure, 13 might not be putting the hurt on somebody, but scoring 13 for fourteen straight weeks would be an undefeated season. Of course this is Vader's, 13-11…

Match #11: (B Div.) Inconsistently Consistent @ Put It on Matt's Tab. Matt's Tab just got torched by an 0-2 team. Consistent, down from A, just lost two in a row to teams up from C. I officially have no idea what to expect in B. I'll randomly guess Consistent, 13-11.
Match #12: (F Div.) Coach's Last Dance @ Rippin Darts. Can Rippin cruise to a 4-0 start? Nope. But they do eke one out. 14-10.
